defeated_student_causes.why_failed: The submitted Dancing Links implementation is syntactically truncated, using `max_no` instead of the declared `max_nodes`, causing a runtime error.
It enumerates all combinations of k configurations, leading to infeasible exponential running time.
It reduces the problem to matching technicians and hardware units first and then handles shifts locally, which is not valid because all three coordinates must be simultaneously distinct.

recommended_edit: Hide the exact-cover structure in the narrative: describe each input triple as a certified record containing three abstract resource identifiers and define validity as those records forming a partition of the full resource universe, with the three resource categories explained through an indirect mapping rather than the explicit 'each technician, hardware unit, and shift exactly once' wording.
